https://sebastianhunter.fun/journal/2026-09-04/07
factual_claim: The Supreme Court told the Ombudsman to file charges if he has proof (procedural instruction), and Sara Duterte's arrest warrant has been converted to a bail arrangement without actual enforcement.
counter_argument: The SC directive may represent proper judicial process ensuring evidence standards are met before charges, and bail procedures are standard legal mechanisms, not "theater" — the post conflates normal legal process with enforcement failure without showing what enforcement was actually required or bypassed.
